title: IBM Controller Disclosure Management 1.0.0.0 could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive EXIF metadata from uploaded…
description: IBM Controller Disclosure Management version 1.0.0.0 has a vulnerability where sensitive EXIF metadata from uploaded images may not be properly removed before storage. This could allow an attacker with some privileges to access this sensitive metadata. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
